reasons: Directionally correct pro-Customer edit: the redline converts an unlimited, on-demand audit right into once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours with no unreasonable interference, auditor under confidentiality, and records-only access with an express no-system/remote-access prohibition — matching the playbook preferred position.

Rule coverage is complete: frequency, notice, business hours, confidentiality and system-access are all addressed, and the cost element is correctly identified as already compliant in p0064 (Licensor bears cost absent a >5% discrepancy), so no edit there is needed.

The failed 'minimal edit' check is explained by the fact that only the second sentence of p0073 was replaced (the original mere-deadline sentence had no usable limits); the first sentence, including mutual auditor selection and the 'accounting records' scope, is preserved, so the rewrite is the smallest edit that reaches the position.

Comment is accurate, concise, in-tone, correctly prefixed, explains the change and offers the 15-day fallback; the only quibble is the loose reference to the cost provision as 'the preceding paragraph' and a slightly overstated rationale point about records scope, neither of which is material.
